name: spotinder-theme
description: Tema WordPress do Spotinder — WordPress + Parcel + TailwindCSS + Swup + React

scripts.dev: node scripts/parcel.mjs watch src/js/app.js src/css/app.css src/css/login.css --dist-dir dist --no-hmr --no-content-hash
